summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for OnQuest. 15/15 backend tests pass (auth, feed, explore, quest CRUD, like, comment, AI summary author/non-author, persistence). Frontend: login flow, feed render with seeded 'Himalayan Sunrise Trail', quest detail with hero+Leaflet map+flowchart+AI summary, like toggle, and comment posting all verified end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport.

issues: Hero/cover image showed unrelated invoice/menu (last picked image from web ImagePicker in earlier session). Cosmetic only — backend stores whatever base64 user picks. Not a bug.

react_native_issues.issue: Tab labels rendered as plain Text divs that are not directly clickable by Playwright get_by_text — TouchableOpacity wrapper sits in tab bar layout; pressing through tab bar works in real mobile (verified via redirect to /feed after login). For testability, consider adding testID like tab-create / tab-profile on each Tabs.Screen tabBarButton.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID props on bottom tab buttons (tab-feed, tab-explore, tab-create, tab-profile) to make navigation deterministic in automated tests.
(Optional) On web, expo-image-picker can pick any image — in production consider validating image MIME/dimensions.
No code fixes required; all required features are functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~410 lines — acceptable for MVP but could be split (auth, quests, users) as it grows.
JWT secret correctly read from env; bcrypt hashes verified ($2b$ format).

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True — browsers will refuse credentialed requests; not affecting current Bearer-token flow but should be tightened to explicit origin if cookie auth is enabled.
ai_summary endpoint correctly enforces author-only (403 for non-author verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, feed, detail, like, comment, AI summary visible, logout reachable)

seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded admin@onquest.in/admin123 and explorer@onquest.in/explorer123 via server.seed(); sample 'Himalayan Sunrise Trail' quest with 3 geo-located nodes. Tests created TEST_Quest under a fresh test_<ts>@onquest.in user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://onquest-flowmap.preview.emergentagent.com. Login testIDs are login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn (not login-email/etc). Quest cards use testID quest-card-<uuid>. AI summary uses gemini-2.5-flash via emergentintegrations and works with current EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
